title: Classes
intro: Make a class, give it worksheets and show one link. The children tap their picture and play. You see how many answers each child got right on the first try.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
signInTitle: Sign in to see your classes
signInBody: Classes and results belong to your account.
planBody: With the {plan} plan you make classes, share one class link and see each child's results. Below is an example with made-up children.
lapsedBanner: Your {plan} plan is not active. You can still read and delete everything here. The class link stays closed for children until the plan is active again.
formNamesHelp: Type one name per line. First names or nicknames only, no last names.
formNumbersHelp: No name is stored. Each child gets a number and a picture.
errClassName: Please type a name for the class (up to 60 characters).
errSeatName: A name can have up to 24 characters and up to three words, and no @ sign.
errSeatCap: A class has up to {n} children.
errClassCap: You can have up to {n} classes.
errIconTaken: Another child already has this picture.
errLink: This is not the address of a page on this site.
errLinkNotFound: No page was found at this address.
errPrintOnly: This page is for printing only. Nothing on it can be checked on screen.
errWorkCap: A class has up to {n} worksheets.
refused: Not added (first names or nicknames only): {list}
stepsTitle: Three steps to the first results
stepLink: Show the class link to the children.
resultsNone: No results yet. They appear here when a child presses “Check Answers” on a page.
firstCheck: Each result comes from the first time the child pressed “Check Answers” on a page: it shows how many answers were right on that first try.
legendNow: Outlined: the level the child is on now
cellOf: {right} of {total} right on the first try
deleteResultsConfirm: Delete everything this child has played?
pickPicture: Pick a picture no child has yet
removeChildConfirm: Remove this child and their results?
printHint: Each child's picture with their name or number, to hang up or hand out.
privacyNote: Only two things are stored about a child: what you type here (a first name or nickname, or nothing in a numbers-only class) and the results of the pages they play.
workLabel: Address of a page on LessonCraftStudio
workHelp: Paste the address of a worksheet that can be played on screen, a Level Set, or an activity, or the student link of a worksheet you made.
workRemoveConfirm: Remove this worksheet and its results?
workExisting: This is already in the class.
linkHelp: Show this link or the QR code to the children. They tap their picture. No account and no password.
linkQrAlt: QR code of the class link
linkClosed: The link is closed for children while your plan is not active.
toNumbersConfirm: This deletes every name in this class for good. Continue?
newLinkConfirm: The old link and QR code will stop working. Continue?
deleteClassConfirm: The class, the children and every result will be deleted for good. Continue?
retention: Results are deleted when you delete them, when a class has not been used for 14 months, or 60 days after your plan ends.
skillsIntro: The class’s work under the headings of the standards. For each child, the most recent result under a heading counts.
skillsEmpty: Nothing to show yet. Add a worksheet, a Level Set or an activity under “Worksheets”.
skillsOutside: Not named in these standards for these grades
skillsAssigned: “{title}” was added to the class’s worksheets.
skillsOtherNote: Your own worksheets and pages without a skill code cannot be placed.
skillsPrintHint: To keep a file, choose to save as a PDF in the print window.
reportIntro: This page shows what your child practiced on screen in class and how the first try went. It is one sign among many, not a grade.
formNameHelp: Do not put a child's name here.
confirmText: I confirm: (1) I use class links for teaching. My school allows me to use online tools in which children work under a number, or I am a private tutor or a parent and decide this myself. (2) I will not put a child's name or other personal details in the class name. (3) I have read the "Classes and results" section of the privacy policy and accept the data processing terms for classes.
